svg.desc: Rishikesh S. Full-stack engineer. TypeScript, fast backends, practical AI workflows. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, C++, Solidity. Frontend: React, Next.js, React Native, Remotion, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui. Backend and data: Node.js, Express, Hono, FastAPI, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Drizzle. Cloud and infra: AWS, Vercel, Docker, Serverless, Linux. Tooling and quality: Git, GitHub, Vitest, Turborepo, Bun, Zod, Sentry, PostHog, Mixpanel. Auth: Clerk, Better Auth. AI: AI agents, RAG, AI SDK, Mastra. A terminal window lists: role, full-stack engineer; based in, india; likes, reliable software, clean dev workflows; ships, products that survive real users; editor, zed; ask me, system design, ai agents, why typescript; site, rishikeshs.net.
